steps.content: At the center of the stage, Joan is strumming her guitar furiously, the wild and surging melody sending tremors through every seat.
A storm of jeers and insults rises from the crowd below, but Joan doesn't care. Compared to hate comments in a livestream chat, this is practically a standing ovation.

Hurried footsteps echo from the shadows as wave after wave of security personnel pour out to catch her. But she simply tears across the stage, guitar clutched to her chest, weaving through every attempt to corner her.
Audio cables lie tangled across the floor in every direction, snagging at her ankles more than once. Still, that's not enough to slow her charge toward the front of the stage.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Wow, you can't even dodge a guitar? So much for an angel's bodyguard.
The music continues to build up, surging into its most electrifying passage yet.

The fans' verbal attacks don't let up for a second either, yet all that seething hostility does nothing to derail the performance. If anything, it's fuel to the fire, driving the chaotic, feverish show step by step toward its climax.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: An unplanned variable has emerged. While it works in our favor, from an organizational discipline standpoint... It seems you'll need to tighten management, Chief.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A tamed Joan couldn't write music like this. Take the win and shut it.
Using the chaotic performance as cover, you and Schorl lead the elite team to quietly close in on the target location, neutralizing every staff member you cross along the way.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief... we've successfully infiltrated backstage! We've located the glow stick hub as well. Moving in as we speak!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Good work, we're almost at the control room. But why's your voice shaking?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I'm just... excited! I've never been a part of an operation this big, after all!
The driving rock beat perfectly masks the team's movements. The strike team alongside Wynn has already surrounded and secured the entire equipment area.
Eugene is standing guard at the sole entrance, running a final magazine check. Cole follows close behind, eyes drifting to a large Phanuel promotional poster on the wall.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: We're about to sabotage your idol's concert. Try not to get so worked up that you mess up.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Relax, I've done plenty of distraction resistance training. Even if Phanuel herself showed up right in front of me, I could hold myself back from asking for a handshake!
The first chorus ends, its restless melody still lingering. Joan brings her worn pick to her lips, gives it a light kiss, then flings it with a flourish into the angry crowd below.

She has made this stage entirely her own, lost in her music and the release it brings. She coolly produces another pick, readying herself for the next passage, completely oblivious to the predatory eyes below.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Jane, stand down! Joan's one of us.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: She trespassed, disrupted order, resisted with violence, and... the adjutant paid me a lot.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief just passed down new orders. This chaos is exactly what we need right now. We need it to continue.
After a full three or four seconds of silence, Jane lowers her weapon and turns her back to the stage.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: ...Copy that. Protecting the target, Joan.

The words are barely out of her mouth when two security guards charge up the stairs and toward the stage. Jane steps into position, drives her rifle stock straight into the first man's chest, and shoves them both back in a single motion. As she does, she catches more guards creeping in from the stage's blind spots in the corner of her eye.

Jane immediately pulls back and raises her weapon, placing her shots precisely at the guard's feet to drive him off. The two muffled gunshots vanish into the music, unnoticed by the crowd below. Only Joan, up on stage, catches every beat of the skirmish unfolding in the shadows.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Keep playing. I'll handle the floor.
Joan raises an eyebrow, grins, and immediately turns to the crowd and flips them off.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: This next one goes out to the megastar who treats other people's original work like it doesn't exist, and her almighty team that makes it all happen!
A few brief, muffled sounds of a scuffle crack through the comms before quickly settling. Schorl's calm, electronic voice cuts through.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Our team has safely reached the control room. To prevent the situation from spiraling out of control prematurely, Chief intends to conduct one final negotiation with Eliza. All units are to stand by and await further orders.
The threats in the equipment room have been largely neutralized. The tech team is running final checks on the explosive device set to destroy the signal hub.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: All units, report in.

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: All non-essential personnel have been cleared from the entrances and exits. The east audience corridor has been evacuated, and all fire exits are open.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: We've completed a sweep of all other areas as well. Stands, restrooms, storage rooms, server room. No secondary Mania source found anywhere.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Good work. Everybody, stand by.
[Below the Stage]
Phanuel is still waiting alone below the stage. Just then, an unfamiliar blonde woman with a guitar on her back swings past overhead.
So cool! Is that a guitar? Eliza once thought about having me learn an instrument, but there wasn't anything I particularly liked... or disliked, really...
The guitar's sound filters through her earpiece, and Phanuel begins to hum along.
It sounds a lot like my song, but... something's different? What, though...?
She recalls her reflection in the mirror, and Eliza's. Recalls herself under the blazing sun, and Chief.
I'm different from all of them, I think...?
[Control Room]

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Where's the stage manager? Why's that person still up there? Get someone to remove her immediately. By whatever means necessary.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Cut the lights and sound too. Use any excuse you can—a warm-up act, whatever. Just skip past this part and redirect the crowd's attention.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: And get Phanuel in position now. You have three minutes to get her on stage!
But no matter how hard she hammers the intercom, nothing but static and corrupted noise answers her.
If you're waiting for Phantom Entertainment to come to your rescue, that's not happening. Just so you know.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Bureau verified this in advance. They've submitted the documents already, formally withdrawing all investment and cutting all ties with you and Mirrormoon.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: I knew you wouldn't give up so easily. Guards—
The moment Eliza raises the intercom, Schorl's laser finds its mark and blasts it to pieces.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're the one who should give up. The Bureau has taken control of this whole place.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: ...I should've dealt with you on the street when I had the chance.

She still stands her ground, even positioning herself in front of the control panel. You've already looked into Eliza. She's just an ordinary person with no powers. In a Mania case like this, she's nothing more than an operative who's being used.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What exactly did Phantom Entertainment offer to make you go this far? Well, the Bureau will get to the bottom of this whether you answer or not, of course. It only determines your fate here.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Hahaha... I've worked as a talent manager for years now, and I've dealt with all kinds of people in the industry. So, I'd like to think I'm a decent judge of character. And from what you just said, I can already tell—

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: You have a fulfilling life, don't you? Every day has meaning, a purpose. Your efforts are recognized. I've done my research. People like you were never my target.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I don't detect any signs of willingness to cooperate with the investigation. Immediate disposal recommended—
You step in front of Schorl.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: See? You want to spare me. Just like how you tried to get through to Phanuel. You managed to get all that evidence, fought your way here... She's helped you quite a bit, I'd assume? Bet you think your efforts paid off, huh? You must be real proud of yourself right now.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: You urged her to find her own voice, urged the crowd to wake up, and now you're urging me to turn over a new leaf and cooperate with your investigation. Then what? Can you take responsibility for every single one of those thirty thousand people?

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: You can't. Be honest, Chief. You don't care one bit about what kind of lives those nobodies lead after the show ends, about the things happening in every corner of this city...

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: But I do. I know what they like to watch, what they need, what troubles them, what time of day they pick up their phones and which platforms they check. I know them even better than they know themselves.
She lists her methods of lining her pockets one by one, as though tallying up her trophies.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to take something that costs next to nothing and sell it to them at dozens of times the price. Crazy? Absurd? Oh, believe me, they know. But look at them. They love every second of it, no? Can you make them smile with pure bliss like that, Chief?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You make it sound so romantic, but they're really just drowning in a delusion. A scam.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: And do you honestly think they wouldn't have lost themselves in delusions if Phanuel weren't around? They'll only start looking at other stars, at other forms of entertainment.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Phanuel's power is no different from the kind of brainwashing those people do. It's just a faster, easier method. You can't understand it simply because this particular trap was never meant for you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I would never deny people the right to seek comfort. But that's no excuse for using special powers to influence, poison minds, and make a profit off of manipulating them! Since you've made up your mind to take the fall for all of this... you'll bear the consequences of your failure too.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Failure? Hahaha... I told you, I'm a good judge of character. There were so many young, pretty girls in Eastside. Phanuel can't even sing or dance that well. Did you really think I chose her solely for her powers?

As soon as she finishes speaking, Eliza slowly loosens her grip on the documents she had been using as cover. Tendrils of deep violet mist rise from her palm, spreading rapidly until they fill every corner of the room.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: A psychoactive smoke. She was stalling!

Schorl moves instantly, stepping in front of you and deploying a shield. The sudden mental trap throws your team's formation into disarray. The mist spreads at terrifying speed in the sealed space, cutting off sight lines and dulling all senses.
The external comms channel crackles restlessly. Everyone's waiting for the next order from the control room.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I'm running low on ammo. This isn't good...

Even with your hands clamped over your mouth and nose, you couldn't avoid breathing in traces of the mist. Your vision fractures, the afterimages of the equipment beginning to overlap. Fragments of sounds that shouldn't be there pierce your ears, overwhelming them. Your reason and senses are being corrupted, pulled apart at the seams.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So this is how you controlled Phanuel... How long have you been doing this to her...?

An intense wave of dizziness and numbness crashes through your body. You reach out for the wall, pressing against it to keep yourself upright, jaw clenched. You do what you can to force your mind back together.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ha. A good judge of character, was it? All you can see are people's weaknesses. Yes, people can be frail, avoidant, dependent... but you're blind to everything that actually makes them worth something.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm standing before you precisely because there are those who choose to fight against an unjust hand, who choose to shoulder responsibility and face danger head-on, who choose to fight for a real connection... And these are the very same things that will bring your downfall.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief. Awaiting your orders.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Game over, Eliza.

The moment the words leave your lips, your fractured senses snap back into focus. The shackles lash out, sweeping the toxic mist away in one clean motion. Your vision clears completely, and only then does Eliza realize that someone had already silently slipped behind her, using the mist as cover.
Still, she tries to fight back. Only this time, Schorl gives her no such opening. A laser finds her left shoulder with pinpoint precision.
Meanwhile, Evie has already switched on the venue-wide microphone.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Hello everyone, I'm Evie, an employee at Otriana... I know that none of you really care, but... I've got to say this anyway. I'm here for a friend of mine.
[Stage]

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Evie...

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: She's the most incredible person I've ever met. She always jokes about not having the best education or the best background, yet she got herself to the same place as everyone who had a head start, all on her own!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: She scrimps and saves every day, hits every impossible target they throw at her, and pushes herself to the limit just to earn a shot at a permanent position.

Joan perceptively slows down, pulling the melody back for the person speaking. Elsewhere, Jane, worn down by the prolonged battle, yet holds on. Despite her ammunition being spent, and despite her body having long gone past its limits.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: What makes her truly incredible is that she'd still look up at the sky, even in that lifeless office! She could see the hope beyond her little desk, the vibrant world on the other side of the glass, and she saw... me, an exhausted, worn-down soul.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: It's tiring, isn't it? Living up to your family's expectations, chasing goals endlessly in a city that still feels foreign to you. That's why Phanuel drew you in. That's why you felt like you belonged here. Right, Tracy?
With every word Evie says, the mental synchronization that has gripped the venue begins to quietly loosen. The comms go silent as each unit holds its position, waiting for the right moment to move.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I'm not here to stop you! I won't turn you away like I did last time!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Starting today, I want to cheer for Phanuel right alongside you!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Because, Tracy, you're the toughest, most incredible person I know! I believe in your choices! Tracy, and everyone, please believe in yourselves! Stay true to yourself, and love what you love!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Tracy, can you hear me? I'm not cheering for a Cherub, or anyone's fan. I'm cheering for "you"!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Please, find your own voices again! I'd love to meet more of you. The real you!
[Stage Shakes]

The moment Evie's speech ends, her sincerity takes shape as tiny, warm orange dots of light, riding the waves of sound and spreading through the venue. The tiny sparks weave through the crowd and the equipment, dispersing the hardened synchronization waves and shattering the mental grip that has held the entire stadium captive.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Data's within range. Eugene!
Bang! The final note of Joan's song lands at the same moment as the explosion.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Energy device destroyed!

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: All clear on my end! The audience hasn't caught on to us!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: The glow sticks of the fans outside are going out too!

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Thought you were actually gonna throw me under the bus. Didn't think you'd actually pull it off—

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: All guards near the main stage cleared. Joan is safe. Mission complete.
